::: {#exr-enrollment}
#### Who takes what

Three students take courses as follows.

| Student | Courses |
|---|---|
| Ana | 201, 241 |
| Ben | 241 |
| Cy | 201, 247 |

Let $E(s, c)$ be "student $s$ takes course $c$",
where $s$ ranges over the students
and $c$ over the courses 201, 241 and 247.
Which of these are true?

1. $\forall s, \exists c, E(s, c)$
2. $\exists c, \forall s, E(s, c)$
3. $\forall c, \exists s, E(s, c)$
4. $\exists s, \forall c, E(s, c)$

:::
